name: singlet_neighbors_approximate_knn_search
title: Approximate kNN graph with exact-recall check
description: Builds the cell neighbour graph from an obsm embedding (default X_pca): exact search below auto.exact_threshold_n cells, NN-descent above, with approximate indices tuned to a recall target measured against exact search on a random cell sample. Writes sparse distances and connectivities under obsp/<key> and a recall, timing and memory report under uns/<key>_recall_report. Run after an embedding exists and before clustering or UMAP. Do not use on raw counts, for batch-corrected graphs (neighbors.batch_aware_knn_graph), to choose the neighbour count (neighbors.neighbor_count_selection) or for non-Euclidean metrics.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

use_rep.description: Key of the obsm embedding to search (cells by dimensions); must contain no missing values.

key.description: Stem of the output members obsp/<key>_distances, obsp/<key>_connectivities, uns/<key> and uns/<key>_recall_report.

n_neighbors.description: Neighbours per cell, self excluded; at most the number of cells minus one. Scanpy's default graph corresponds to 14.

metric.description: Distance metric; only euclidean is supported in this release.

backend.description: Index. auto picks brute below auto.exact_threshold_n, else nn_descent. brute is exact; the others are approximate and tuned to validation.target.

exact_threshold_n.description: Cell count below which auto uses exact search.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available. nn_descent and hnsw always run on CPU.

seed.description: Random seed for the query sample, trees, quantiser and approximate-index randomness.

validation.description: Recall check against exact search and optional downstream agreement check.

sample_size.description: Number of uniformly sampled query cells used to measure recall against exact search.

target.description: Mean recall an approximate backend must reach on the sample; its breadth parameter is raised until it does.

downstream_ari.description: Also run Leiden on the approximate and the exact graph and record their ARI against an exact seed control; adds clustering time.

downstream_resolution.description: Leiden resolution for the downstream check; used only when downstream_ari is true.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members with the same key instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsp/knn_distances. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: backend (requested and resolved), device, n_cells, n_dims, n_neighbors, seed, tuned parameters, recall (sample_size, mean_R_k, p05_cell_recall, target, target_met, mean_miss_depth, cells_with_ties), timing_s, peak_memory_gb, graph (n_connected_components) and downstream (null unless requested). Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device and the backend that would be used.
